note: Frozen before the first model run. Changes require a new version entry and re-run disclosure.

elo.update_order: chronological by date_iso then week then slug

margin_scale.criterion: minimize MSE vs actual home margin on fit window
margin_scale.applies_to: holdout evaluation and Week 9 own lines

totals_model.formula: expected_total = train_window_mean_total + shrink*(off_home_prior - league) + shrink*(off_away_prior - league)
totals_model.shrink: g/(g+4) where g = team games played before this game (season prior only)

baselines.B0_constant: p = mean designated-home expected score on weeks 1-4, applied to all holdout games
baselines.B1_record_diff: p = 1/(1+exp(-5*(wpct_home_pre - wpct_away_pre))) with c=5 fixed a priori; pre-game win pct uses games strictly before the picked game

evaluation.primary_metric: Brier on holdout weeks 5-8 with outcome y in {1, 0.5 tie, 0}
secondary: calibration intercept/slope via logistic fit (reported, small-n caveated)
evaluation.multiple_testing: all strategies registered before evaluation; no post-hoc strategy additions to leaderboard without registry version bump

validation_gates.G1_provenance: every input row carries official source URL; retrieval date recorded
validation_gates.G2_leakage: walk-forward only; parameters fit on weeks 1-4; holdout weeks 5-8 untouched until final evaluation
validation_gates.G4_baseline: holdout Brier strictly better than B0 and B1
validation_gates.G6_registry: strategy listed in strategy_registry.json v1 before evaluation
validation_gates.G7_market: requires official operator price archive to compare model vs market; BLOCKED while no official line source exists
validation_gates.G8_costs: requires official operator settlement/limits terms; BLOCKED

signals.neutral_site_handling: neutral games (official international series) excluded from home-advantage primary estimate, reported separately

rewards.policy: leaderboard reward eligibility requires ALL gates G1-G8 PASS; ranking metric = holdout Brier (lower better), tie-break = log loss
rewards.note: No reward pool terms are published by any official source; amounts left blank and flagged.
